newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil ticks up with futures, steady premiums.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil ticks up with futures, steady premiums.

text.p: NWE gas oil was a touch stronger on the back of firmer IPE futures and broadly steady premiums.
April IPE gas oil was trading $1.00 a tonne higher at $166.50.

Traders said physical gas oil activity was fairly muted and that heating oil premiums had eased about 50 cents from Tuesday. Bids of April IPE -50 cents fob ARA for first half April were being countered with offers of April IPE +50 cents.
Diesel barges were pegged around April IPE +$10-12 fob.
The spread between bids and offers on Russian cargoes widened this morning with buying interest heard at April IPE +25 cents cif ARA against sellers who were looking for April IPE +$2.

DIN and FOD were still attracting similar prices to Tuesday, although nothing was heard. Traders said FOD sellers may be holding on to April IPE +$4 cif NWE on the back of tightish supplies, but against this is only moderate interest at around April IPE +$2.
